name: Google
source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_2026_logo.svg (original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ee/Google_2026_logo.svg; cross-checked against the live https://www.google.com/ homepage logo SVG, 2026-10-07)
notes: Current Google wordmark (in use since 2026-05-19; replaces the 2015 wordmark, kept at work/google/google_2015.json). Original is six per-letter paths in brand colours (blue/red/yellow/blue/green/red); fill colours dropped so every letter takes the single app colour - letters are separate, non-overlapping paths, so nothing blobs. No transforms, no background, no text elements. Counters (o, o, g bowl, e eye) are inner subpaths and knock out under evenodd (they also wind opposite, so nonzero renders identically). Paths reordered left-to-right (G, o, o, g, l, e); coordinates verbatim from the Commons SVG (whitespace collapsed only), which match google.com's own SVG shifted by 6.98 units in y. Uses Q and arc commands (Path2D handles both). viewBox is the tight bbox; the g descender sets the bottom edge. Suits Pixel phones (EXIF Make "Google").
